name: ai-presentation-maker-desktop
description: AI Presentation Maker - desktop stack (Electron + React + TypeScript)
author: MyAI

scripts.test:integration: node scripts/require-tests.mjs tests/integration && vitest run tests/integration
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/require-tests.mjs tests/e2e && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:visual: node scripts/require-tests.mjs tests/visual && vitest run tests/visual
scripts.eval:live: node scripts/require-tests.mjs tests/eval/live && vitest run tests/eval/live
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:golden && npm run test:load && npm run test:security && npm run test:visual
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:golden: node scripts/require-tests.mjs tests/golden && vitest run tests/golden
scripts.test:load: node scripts/require-tests.mjs tests/load && vitest run tests/load
scripts.test:security: node scripts/require-tests.mjs tests/integration/ipcSecurity.test.ts tests/credentials.test.ts && vitest run tests/integration/ipcSecurity.test.ts tests/credentials.test.ts
